title: tideguard: a decision-aware model-selection harness for data-scarce surveillance forecasting
description: Open, reusable evaluation harness and decision-aware, baseline-first model-selection rule for data-scarce surveillance forecasting. Reproduces a rolling-origin benchmark of forecasting configurations (persistence, statistical, machine- and deep-learning baselines, zero-shot foundation models, and LoRA fine-tuning) across two wastewater surveillance systems and four pathogens, with site-clustered uncertainty, surge-detection decision metrics, and Model Confidence Set (Hansen et al., 2011) model selection.
